# Poly From PFE

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Reconstruct the rational polynomial with simple poles -2 and -1 and residues 1. Its coefficient vectors represent (3+2x)/(2+3x+x²).

## What this example demonstrates

Reconstruct the rational polynomial with simple poles -2 and -1 and residues 1. Its coefficient vectors represent (3+2x)/(2+3x+x²).
